# IBenjiArkEvents
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/events/arks/IBenjiArkEvents.sol)

**Title:**
IBenjiArkEvents

Custom events for `BenjiArk`


## Events
### SwapPoolWhitelisted
Emitted when a SwapPool's whitelist status is updated by the curator.


```solidity
event SwapPoolWhitelisted(address indexed swapPool, bool isWhitelisted);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`swapPool`|`address`|The SwapPool address whose status changed|
|`isWhitelisted`|`bool`|The new whitelist status|
